title: SPORAGON
tagline: Hexxagon in the back of a forgotten fridge.
description: A Hexxagon-style mould war on a cracked egg tray: your Penicillium against the computer's Rhizopus, every colony, slime bridge and stain painted procedurally into 256 colours. Rust on an emulated VESA SVGA card, native and in the browser.

cover.alt: A hexagonal egg tray in a grimy fridge, two green Penicillium and two white Rhizopus colonies in its corners and three cups knocked out of its centre; embossed label strips on the wall show the score and "YOUR MOVE".
